note: sha256 pins of vendored files (DESIGN-REVIEW S7): sha256 is the stock file in node_modules, patched.sha256 the bytes copied into dist/_mw after the hash-asserted patches (v0.2.1 B3 request headers; code review round 1: no OPFS chunks cleanup, no FSA polyfill on host globals). node build.mjs fails when either differs or a patch point moved; after reviewing an upgrade, run node build.mjs --update-lock. v0.3 (MF-78): "packages" pins every other package the bundles take from node_modules (name, version, sha256 of the package files, the tarball integrity of package-lock.json); a bundled package that is not pinned, or whose source changed, fails the build.
review: Two people review every change to this file. The pull request that changes it needs the approval of a code owner who did not write it (.github/CODEOWNERS), and that reviewer compares the new package source with its upstream release before approving (V03-DESIGN-REVIEW 2.19, SC-2). Nobody runs --update-lock and merges alone.
